description: Clippy desktop assistant with LAN models, MCP tools, screenshots and GigaAM voice input
pre_install: if (Get-Process -Name Clippy -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { throw 'Close Clippy via its tray menu > Exit before installing or updating.' }
pre_uninstall: if (Get-Process -Name Clippy -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { throw 'Close Clippy via its tray menu > Exit before updating or uninstalling.' }
notes: Run clippy or use the Clippy LAN Start menu shortcut.
Before updating, close Clippy via its tray menu > Exit.
Settings remain in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Clippy; saved API keys remain in Windows Credential Locker.
Portable Windows x64 build; .NET and Windows App SDK are included.
